
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/cc-notes/p/19461000" title="发布于 2026-01-21 13:53">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">[Docker 20.10.7] 如何使用kylin iso文件构建出docker镜像</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        本文详细介绍如何使用kylin v10 iso文件构建出docker镜像
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="1-前言">1. 前言</h1>
<p>本文详细介绍如何使用 kylin v10 iso 文件构建出 docker image，docker 版本为 20.10.7。</p>
<h1 id="2-构建-yum-离线源">2. 构建 yum 离线源</h1>
<h2 id="21-挂载-iso-文件">2.1. 挂载 ISO 文件</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">mount Kylin-Server-V10-GFB-Release-030-ARM64.iso /media
</code></pre>
<h2 id="22-添加离线-repo-文件">2.2. 添加离线 repo 文件</h2>
<p>在<code>/etc/yum.repos.d/</code>下创建<code>kylin-local.repo</code>，并添加如下内容</p>
<pre><code class="language-ini">[kylin-local]
name = Kylin Local
baseurl = file:///media/
gpgcheck = 0
enabled = 1
</code></pre>
<h2 id="23-生成元数据缓存">2.3. 生成元数据缓存</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">dnf clean all &amp;&amp; dnf makecache
</code></pre>
<h1 id="3-构建系统环境">3. 构建系统环境</h1>
<h2 id="31-创建系统安装目录">3.1. 创建系统安装目录</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">mkdir -p /opt/kylin-minimal
</code></pre>
<h2 id="32-安装最小系统">3.2. 安装最小系统</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">dnf groupinstall "Minimal" --installroot /opt/kylin-minimal
</code></pre>
<h2 id="33-验证系统环境">3.3. 验证系统环境</h2>
<p>执行<code>chroot /opt/kylin-minimal</code>命令进入最小系统的根目录，执行<code>ll</code>命令查看目录结构。</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash">[root@node0 /]# ll
total 16
lrwxrwxrwx  1 root root    7 Apr  2  2021 bin -&gt; usr/bin
dr-xr-xr-x  7 root root 4096 Jan  3 08:58 boot
drwxr-xr-x  2 root root   42 Jan  3 08:57 dev
drwxr-xr-x 88 root root 8192 Jan  3 08:58 etc
drwxr-xr-x  2 root root    6 Apr  2  2021 home
lrwxrwxrwx  1 root root    7 Apr  2  2021 lib -&gt; usr/lib
lrwxrwxrwx  1 root root    9 Apr  2  2021 lib64 -&gt; usr/lib64
drwxr-xr-x  2 root root    6 Apr  2  2021 media
drwxr-xr-x  2 root root    6 Apr  2  2021 mnt
drwxr-xr-x  2 root root    6 Apr  2  2021 opt
dr-xr-xr-x  2 root root    6 Apr  2  2021 proc
dr-xr-x---  2 root root  140 Jan  3 08:59 root
drwxr-xr-x 16 root root  281 Jan  3 08:56 run
lrwxrwxrwx  1 root root    8 Apr  2  2021 sbin -&gt; usr/sbin
drwxr-xr-x  2 root root    6 Apr  2  2021 srv
dr-xr-xr-x  2 root root    6 Apr  2  2021 sys
drwxrwxrwt  2 root root    6 Jan  3 08:58 tmp
drwxr-xr-x 12 root root  192 Jan  3 08:55 usr
drwxr-xr-x 19 root root  332 Jan  3 08:56 var
</code></pre>
<p>如果显示以上目录结构，则说明最小系统环境安装成功。</p>
<h1 id="4-构建-docker-镜像">4. 构建 docker 镜像</h1>
<h2 id="41-打包系统安装目录">4.1. 打包系统安装目录</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">tar -C /opt/kylin-minimal -cvpf /opt/kylin-minimal.tar .
</code></pre>
<h2 id="42-创建镜像">4.2. 创建镜像</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">cat /opt/kylin-minimal.tar | docker import - kylin-minimal:v10
</code></pre>
<p>根据官方文档介绍，从零构建镜像只有 2 种方式：<code>FROM scratch</code>和<code>using tar</code>。<code>FROM scratch</code>是构建一个空白的镜像，没有任何内容。而<code>using tar</code>是基于 tar 包构建的镜像。上述命令是从 kylin-minimal tar 包构建 docker 镜像。镜像名称为<code>kylin-minimal</code>，标签为<code>v10</code>。</p>
<h2 id="43-查看镜像">4.3. 查看镜像</h2>
<pre><code class="language-bash">docker images ls -a
--------------------
REPOSITORY          TAG       IMAGE ID       CREATED      SIZE
kylin-minimal       v10       4746e82d9656   1 days ago   2.0GB
</code></pre>
<h1 id="5-参考资料">5. 参考资料</h1>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://docs.docker.com/build/building/base-images/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://docs.docker.com/build/building/base-images/</a></li>
</ul>
